title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equation c = sqrt(1/(epsilon_0 * mu_0)).

title: Understanding of Relationships
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the relationship between c, epsilon_0, and mu_0.

title: Justification of Choice
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain why option (c) is the correct choice over (a) and (b).

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check that the units are consistent in the final answer.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid selecting incorrect options (a) or (b) as these are common errors.
